text:
Which statement about a hydrogen–oxygen fuel cell is not correct?
A
Chemical energy is converted into electrical energy.
B
Hydrogen is oxidised.
C
The reaction that takes place is endothermic.
D
Wateris the only chemical product.

options.label: A
options.text: Chemical energy is converted into electrical energy.

options.label: C
options.text: The reaction that takes place is endothermic.
